definitions.explanation: unexpectedly; contrary to expectations; more than one thought

examples.japanese: {思|おも}いのほか⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧だった。
⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{思|おも}いのほか⟦{難|むずか}しかった→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: The exam was harder than I thought.

examples.japanese: {思|おも}いのほか⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかって→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧⟦{遅刻|ちこく}して→遅刻する：22282_chikokusuru⟧しまった。
examples.english: It took longer than expected and I ended up being late.

notes:
{思|おも}いのほか is an adverb meaning "unexpectedly" or "more than one thought."

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧: Thought, expectation
- ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: Possessive particle
- ほか/{外|ほか}: Outside, beyond
- Literally: "Outside of (one's) expectation"

VARIANT WRITINGS:
- {思|おも}いのほか (most common)
- {思|おも}いの{外|ほか} (with kanji)
- ⟦{案外|あんがい}→案外：01699_angai⟧ (similar meaning, different word)

USAGE:
- Describes results that differ from expectations
- Can be positive (easier than expected) or negative (harder than expected)
- Modifies adjectives, verbs, or entire situations

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{意外|いがい}→意外：12741_igai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: Unexpectedly (more neutral)
- ⟦{案外|あんがい}→案外：01699_angai⟧: Contrary to expectations (interchangeable)
- ⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{反|はん}して→反する：11966_hansuru⟧: Contrary to prediction (more formal)
- ⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧: More than I thought (more casual)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {思|おも}いのほか + adjective
- {思|おも}いのほか + verb
- {思|おも}いのほか⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧ (faster than expected)
- {思|おも}いのほか⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧ (takes more time than expected)

REGISTER: Neutral to slightly formal. Common in both spoken and written Japanese.
